parameters.content:
## Purpose
Prepare up to four image derivatives and a print-resolution report from a single trusted source image. Produces real PNG files and verifies their final pixel dimensions instead of merely proposing resize values. Images are fitted inside each configured box, preserving aspect ratio without enlargement or cropping.

## Setup
Run the Manual Trigger with default demo mode to create a local 1200 x 800 sample PNG. No credentials or network needed. For your own image, set mode to download and supply an images.unsplash.com JPEG/PNG URL that you have permission to use. The download host is intentionally restricted and redirects are disabled; this is not a public URL-processing service. Edit the asset name, print dimensions, minimum PPI and one to four derivative sizes in Configuration. The Edit Image node requires GraphicsMagick on non-Docker self-hosted n8n; see the official node documentation.

## Processing
The file signature/size guard accepts PNG/JPEG up to 12 MiB. Image metadata is checked against a 40-megapixel processing limit after decoding. Each output is resized, re-inspected, and compared against the plan. Download PNG binaries and the JSON report from the final node. Low print resolution is flagged for manual review; it does not trigger artificial enlargement or charge an API.

## Limits and recovery
Use trusted images only: size limits are checked after download, and pixel limits after metadata decoding. Decode/network errors stop execution visibly; no automatic retries. Correct the source and rerun. PPI does not certify sharpness or final print framing. Nothing is uploaded or published automatically.

## Attribution
Created by Shisan Hua, who works on [Upscayl](https://upscayl.app/). This workflow uses n8n's native image operations; it does not call Upscayl or claim AI enhancement. No website endpoints are modified.
